verdict.rationale: Galileo provides AI-generated insights via LLM-as-a-judge metrics, hallucination/instruction-adherence detection, agentic metrics, and natural-language feedback that auto-tunes metrics to a domain, plus alerting when anomalies occur—these are genuine AI-generated insights surfaced inside the product. However, the evidence emphasizes evaluation/observability metrics rather than proactive generative 'suggestions' or recommendations for improving prompts/agents, and there's no first-party or independent demonstration of an in-product insight/suggestion UI beyond metric scores and alerts. missing for 10: concrete evidence of generative recommendations/suggestions (e.g., auto-suggested prompt fixes, root-cause narratives) rather than just metrics/alerts, and independent hands-on corroboration of these insights in use.
